primitives.name: Authentication-Gated Metric Access
primitives.verbatim_quote: auth-gated" = needs the free Cognito JWT, not a paid tier.
primitives.assumptions: Access to certain metrics requires valid JWT tokens issued by Cognito, with no paid subscription required.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Token validation fails or is missing, preventing access to restricted data fields.

layer2.mapping: The JWT token serves as an isomorphic key linking private metric access to public API endpoints, enabling secure but transparent data flow.

primitives.name: Behavioral Outcome Location Analysis
primitives.verbatim_quote: - BOLA confirmed on `/api/highlights/participation/game/play` (gameId+playId) and `/api/gamecenter/overview` (gameId, any season).
primitives.assumptions: BOLA can be reconstructed from participation and overview APIs without direct access to proprietary tracking systems.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Missing play-level or game-level identifiers leads to incomplete BOLA reconstruction.

layer2.mapping: BOLA is derived from public participation data using known joins (gameId, playId), forming a kernel of behavioral inference.

primitives.name: Defender Location Vocabulary
primitives.verbatim_quote: - 13-value `defenderLocation` vocabulary captured — the alignment/coverage-disguise feature set.
primitives.assumptions: The 13-value vocabulary captures discrete alignment and coverage states used in defensive positioning analysis.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Insufficient granularity or misclassification of defender positions leads to inaccurate coverage modeling.

layer2.mapping: The 13-value vocabulary forms a discrete feature space for modeling defensive behavior, enabling classification of coverage types.
layer2.telemetry: Observed defender locations mapped to 13 discrete categories via public API responses.
